rv.q: The ease, command, and power of his renditions is awesome, even if this is not your favorite music.
What is indisputable is Felder’s unique gift.

cn.t: Critics praise Felder's virtuosic blend of piano artistry and storytelling, finding his autobiographical show both outstanding and beautifully crafted, though the production's globe-trotting themes hint at the restless life of a performing artist.
